Meet Kristen

Your Botox Bestie
& Nurse Injector

Born and raised in Lubbock, Kristen graduated from Texas Tech University Health Science Center with her Bachelor's of Science in Nursing. With 20 years of experience spanning ICU, cardiac, rehabilitation, and pre/postoperative care, she brings clinical precision to aesthetics that sets her apart.

She's passionate about enhancing your natural beauty — not changing it. Every treatment is tailored, every result intentional. Kristen is Lubbock's only provider of the cutting-edge Everesse monopolar RF system.

Lubbock Exclusive Technology

Meet Everesse

The only provider in Lubbock.

Everesse is a cutting-edge monopolar RF device that lifts, tightens, and volumizes skin — with zero downtime, no numbing required, and results visible after just one session. FDA-cleared and featured in Elle, Cosmopolitan, and The Hollywood Reporter.

No downtime, no numbing required. Continuous water cooling makes this the most comfortable RF experience available.
Dual-depth collagen stimulation at 6.78MHz targets both layers of the dermis for superior lifting and tightening.
Treats face, neck & body with three tip sizes — including areas other RF systems simply can't reach.
Immediate & lasting results. Skin appears lifted and glowing after session one, with continued improvement over months.
✦ Lubbock ExclusiveLush Aesthetics is the only provider of the Everesse monopolar RF system in the Lubbock area. If you want this treatment, Kristen is your girl.
